amendment: User-authorized operational retry-budget extension from 2 to 5 total physical attempts. The historical filename retry-overload does not restrict continuation to overload: any original slot without an eligible accepted answer may continue under the unchanged eligibility rules. No candidate refitting, parameter selection, prompt changes, model substitution or score-based selection is allowed.
prepare: The operator runs --prepare-only after the original collector finishes and releases its lock. Original verifier must report zero errors and current bindings; the exact missing slots, original bytes, candidate freeze and all continuation source hashes are then fixed in supplemental-manifest.json before any extra POST.

selection.slots: Exactly the missing planned original slots with two retained original attempts and no accepted attempt. Retain and report response-model mismatch; never bypass the requested model or pin.
selection.answers: First eligible physical attempt under original completion, expected-count cap, minimum count, exact-or-dated response-model and chronological historical/text/integer-sequence duplicate rules. Every failure and invalid answer is retained.
selection.retries: At most three additional physical attempts per fixed missing slot, numbered 3, 4, 5. No request follows an accepted answer.
selection.scoring: No classifiers, predictions or identity probabilities may be loaded during preparation, continuation or integrity verification. Blind evaluation requires combined integrity complete.

request_profile: Clone the original frozen request body, prompt, requested model and endpoint exactly. Preserve the original profile, including its concurrency 4 and max_attempts 2, as original metadata; record the supplemental operational profile separately. Responses low, stream, store false and 8192 output tokens remain unchanged.
preservation: Original manifest, samples, collector, verifier, challenge protocol and candidate freeze remain byte-identical. Only supplemental-manifest.json, supplemental-samples.jsonl, supplemental-raw-traces and separate integrity/adoption reports are created. Preserve original attempts 1 and 2 and all continuation attempts 3 through 5.
trace: Reuse traceTransport; save exact request body, safe status/content-type/request-id and original response bytes with SHA256 and byte count, never authentication headers. Reconstruct an unrecorded interrupted supplemental trace offline before considering another physical attempt.
completion_gate: Run the unchanged original verifier first, accepting its expected incomplete status only with zero errors/current hashes and a finished unlocked original run. Strictly replay every supplemental attempt, verify original-byte preservation and all code/raw/model/body/cap/duplicate bindings, then require merged first-eligible 120 slots / 40 groups. Output combined-integrity.json and prediction-free adoption.json.
